articles.title: Media Does Not Stop at the City Border: Cross-City Spillovers with PyMC-Marketing
articles.shortTitle: Media Does Not Stop at the City Border
articles.description: A geo-level Bayesian MMM with sparse cross-city spillovers built on PyMC-Marketing MuEffect, MaskedPrior, and a pre-specified route mask for multi-market media measurement.
articles.imageAlt: A stylized route diagram showing cross-city media spill from Caracas to Valencia and back, with green arrows on a cream background.

articles.title: PyTensor Beyond PyMC: Building LLM Inference in Python
articles.description: What PyTensor is missing for LLM inference—and how straightforward it is to build. A Python-native exploration of symbolic graphs, GGUF weights, C, Numba, MLX, and the path to a composable LLM runtime.
articles.imageAlt: Alchemize logo over PyTensor and MLX symbols representing LLM inference in Python
